title: Price whole-bridge carriers and constrain the shortened quotient (no new κ)
body:
Replace individual thin-query annihilation by commutation with the whole three-query bridge of pending #6833. Determine the enlarged carrier space and prove that ordinary sector-independent frames do not enlarge transparent transport.

Full-span dense activation has a strictly worse complete invoice than the source for all positive odd arms and 0<κ<1. All 81 central dense masks on the fixed 9|9 root lose at κ=.00337180; the largest exact complete gain upper bound is −42.130440268650981066. This finite claim is only at that benchmark.

The bridge also yields an 18-dimensional quotient with one thin query, and all eighteen native projectors admit local repairs. An exact applicability check of the known bounds in #6398/#6717 nevertheless excludes commuting rank-two stages, uniform rank-three stages and balanced total incidence 54. The retained support theorem and eight prefix floors imply total rank at least 60; this is not a new general rank threshold or an attaining construction.

New relative to #6841/#6845: whole-block carriers, independent exact interval capacities, complete invoice certificates, and a precise quotient-interface obstruction. Disjoint-time packets need not be globally orthogonal. All native, target, thin and idle terms are counted; extra ordinary adapters are optimistically free.

Base: 7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a.
#6833 source: 51f54e3c31f2f3a3e056a483b3ed66ae916ad06a.
Exact Git/SHA256 pins: SOURCES.json, retained/SOURCE-PINS.json and COROLLARY-SOURCES.json.

Reproduce (Python 3.12, stdlib):
```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-block-bridge-carriers
```
Expected: PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE and the independent geometry, price and support/prefix PASS reports.

Executed: eight registered checks, including normal/-O controls; all 13,851 capacities and dual inequalities, 25 source shapes, 18 projector repairs and eight prefix bounds. Independent nullspace and rational-arithmetic implementations agree. Controls detect omitted neutral/dual conditions, false capacity, corrupt dual prices and omitted commutation. Exact 81-case coverage; no randomized search. Fresh export and commit/remote-tree verification pass.

No new κ. Algebraic stage bounds assume characteristic different from two. The mask-price result is scoped; rank 60 is necessary, not known attainable. Larger or noncommuting target representations still require a legal physical interface and complete recursive accounting. All five framework assumptions and the selected frontier remain unchanged.

By @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI GPT-6 Astra Pro assistance and separate proof/implementation review. Credit DreamingOfClouds (#6832/#6833/#6842), Ali Romman (#6398), thu-nmrc (#6717), #6841/#6845 and retained native/helper lineage. Apache-2.0.
